semantic_objective: Make braid execution order and task state legible without relying on color alone.
accessibility_criteria: Every state has a distinct glyph and text label
Normal text contrast is at least 4.5:1
Touch targets are at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels
implementation_constraints: Keep SVG groups addressable by steward id
Do not make this independent artifact deployment-blocking
Map tokens to CSS variables with the --braid- prefix
acceptance_criteria: All nine states are represented in tokens and implementation
State meaning remains distinguishable in grayscale
Layout fits at 320 CSS pixels without horizontal document overflow
rollback: Remove the UI integration while retaining the standalone SVG and token specification.
